title: Comparison refuses a replaced paragraph whose shared bookmark starts or ends inside its text
symptom: compare replaces a paragraph whose bookmarks differ whole, and writes each bookmark both versions hold once; it refuses with "does not keep each bookmark both inputs hold once over the same text" when such a bookmark starts or ends inside that paragraph's text (for instance a `_Ref` bookmark over a caption's label, in a caption that gains another bookmark), and with "comparison cannot revise paragraph boundary structures at" when the shared bookmark sits under another id or inside a hyperlink or content control
workaround: compare the versions before rebuilding their tables of contents (Rust and Python `rebuild_toc`, CLI `oxoffice docx toc rebuild`), then rebuild the contents of the accepted result; for a bookmark added another way, compare that pair in Word or remove the extra bookmark from one version first
